asking.denied: A person denied it ({items}). Nothing was done
asking.never: A person denied it and set {items} to Deny from now on (only a person can change this, in {place}). Nothing was done
asking.noScreen: There is no window to ask for permission on (the app is not open). Have a person allow it in the app's settings, or open the app and call again
asking.timeout: No answer came within {minutes} minutes (the request was withdrawn). Nothing was done
asking.whereSet.both: the "MCP" tab of the app's Project Settings and "Access key" in the Place settings of the project list
asking.whereSet.key: "Access key" in the Place settings of the project list
asking.whereSet.project: the "MCP" tab of the app's Project Settings
